description: "You rewrote the description. Did it fire better — or do you just believe it did?" That belief is n=0 until you test it: invoke when validating a skill or prompt change, asking whether a description actually fires, or A/B-ing prompt wording. The cheap proxy gives a number in minutes; the discipline is naming what it can't see.
